Building a frontend interface for an e-commerce website involves several key steps, including choosing a technology stack, designing the UI/UX, and implementing core features like product listings, shopping carts, and checkout processes.

To help you get started, I can provide some general guidance on the technologies and best practices for building a modern e-commerce frontend. If you'd like to explore specific aspects like recommendation systems or data handling, I can also assist with those.

For example, if you're interested in how to build a recommendation engine for your frontend, I can help you create a model using your user data.

Would you like to know more about the frontend technologies or should we start by creating a recommendation model?

function.name: create_Recommender_Model
function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.
